description: Image Description: The image depicts a ground scene under a fruit tree, with numerous apples scattered across the soil. The apples are primarily yellow, with a few displaying shades of brown, indicating they might be overripe or starting to rot. Some apples are partially buried in the dry, cracked soil, and others are lying on top of small patches of green grass and weeds. The foliage of the tree is visible in the upper part of the image, with large green leaves casting shadows on the ground.
